lead: The 100% electric double-decker tourist bus that covers the 17 key points of Valencia. Hop on and off whenever you like for 24 or 48 hours.
Choose between 24h, 48h or the guided excursion to the Albufera with a boat trip included.

items.kicker: Hop-on Hop-off · Unlimited access 24 h · Most popular
items.title: The Red Bus · 24 hours
items.subtitle: 17 stops · 100% electric bus · Multilingual audio guide · Hop on and off whenever you like
items.body: The most popular option of the València Tourist Bus. For 24 continuous hours from first use you can hop on and off at any of the 17 stops spread across the city, as many times as you like. The fully electric red double-decker bus passes the main monuments, districts and attractions of Valencia: from the historic centre and the Mercado de Colón to the City of Arts and Sciences, the Oceanogràfic, La Marina de València, Las Arenas beach, the Bioparc and the IVAM. Ideal for first-time visitors who want to get a first idea of the city or to organise the day at their own pace. Frequency varies between 15 and 30 minutes in high season, and between 30 and 45 minutes in low season.

items.kicker: Hop-on Hop-off · Unlimited access 48 h · More time, more Valencia
items.title: The Red Bus · 48 hours
items.subtitle: 17 stops · 48 h unlimited · The most recommended option to see everything without rushing
items.body: The most recommended option if you want to see Valencia without rushing. With 48 hours of unlimited access you can split the visit over two days: the first for the City of Arts and Sciences area, the Oceanogràfic and the beach, and the second for the historic centre, the Bioparc and the museums. The 48-hour ticket costs only 2 euros more than the 24-hour one, so the value for money is far better. The same 17 stops, the same 100% electric double-decker bus and the same multilingual audio guide in 10 languages. The 48 hours + entry to the Church of San Nicolás (“The Valencian Sistine Chapel”) option is also available.
facts: €28.00 · Ages 13 and over · Only €2 more than the 24h
48 hours from first use · Every day of the year

items.title: Albufera Bus Turístic
items.subtitle: Return transport · Traditional boat trip · Rice fields · Sunset · 2 hours · From €22
items.body: A different excursion that takes travellers to the Albufera Natural Park, the largest lake in Spain and the birthplace of Valencian paella. The tour includes return transport from Valencia, a traditional boat trip on the lake and the canals among the rice fields, and sunset views over the water. It is a guided experience that combines nature, local culture and unique Mediterranean landscapes in a single trip of about 2 hours. The Red Bus has run this excursion since 1999 as part of its sustainable tourism offer in Valencia.
facts: Approx. 2 hours · Includes return transport from Valencia

blocks.title: Tips to get the most out of the Tourist Bus
items: Buy the 48-hour ticket: it costs only €2 more than the 24h one and lets you see Valencia without rushing by splitting it over two days
Start the route first thing in the morning from stop no. 1 (Pintor Sorolla) to make the most of the day without queues
With the Valencia Tourist Card you get 15% off the adult 24h ticket — the perfect combination to explore the city
Always sit on the open upper deck: the views of Valencia from there are spectacular, especially when passing the Turia Gardens
The Oceanogràfic deserves at least 4 hours; get off at stop 5 first thing and hop back on the bus in the afternoon for the rest of the route
Bear in mind that there are two tourist bus companies in Valencia (red and green): your ticket is only valid on The Red Bus’s red bus
